# Sex differences in the Dark Triad and trait aggression: A variance-weighted interpretation of the bifactor model

## Notes on replication package

1.  The analysis script assumes that the R project environment is set to the folder containing the script and replication objects. File paths are therefore written relative to the project root. The required replication objects are: `replicationData.rds`, `interceptsBPAQ.rds`, `interceptsSD3.rds`, `baselineBoot.rds`, `moderatedBoot.rds`, `saturatedBoot.rds`, `parsimoniousBoot.rds`, `correlatedFactorsBoot.rds`, `psychopathyReferenceBoot.rds`, `narcissismReferenceBoot.rds`. If the script is run from another working directory, file-loading commands may need to be adjusted accordingly.

2.  Bootstrap and Multiple Imputation (MI) procedures can be run either in parallel or sequentially. The replication script exposes several tuning parameters for these parts of the analysis: `runBootstraps`, `parallelSupported`, `availableCores`, the number of bootstrap iterations `B`, the number of MI plausible value draws for the full sample `M`, and the number of MI plausible value draws within bootstrap samples `MB`, respectively. If `restartBootstraps` is set to `TRUE`, the script regenerates the bootstrap matrices. If `parallelSupported` is set to `TRUE`, the bootstrap is run in parallel using `pbmcapply()` from the `pbmcapply` package, with the number of cores determined by `availableCores`. If `parallelSupported` is set to `FALSE`, the script uses `lapply()` instead.

3.  Attempting to replicate the bootstrap analyses without parallel computation is not adviced, as multi-stage CFA and SEM model fitting (full pipeline) can be computationally expensive. To facilitate reproduction of the reported estimates and avoid requiring users to rerun the full bootstrap procedures, the bootstrap result matrices used in the manuscript are included in the replication package as `.rds` files. The script defaults to using these files for the final bootstrap-based p-value calculations.

### Tuning parameters

```{r}

RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
masterSeed <- 779

runBootstraps      <- FALSE
parallelSupported  <- TRUE
availableCores     <- 15    # Number of parallel workers
B                  <- 9999  # Bootstrap resamples
M                  <- 500   # Multiple imputation draws
MB                 <- 20    # Multiple imputations draws inside each bootstrap resample
restartBootstraps  <- FALSE # Delete stored results and regenerate bootstrap matrices
runRegularization  <- FALSE # Run regularized CFA instead of using stored results
export             <- TRUE  # Export tables and figures
```

## **Helpers**

```{r}

stretchLatexTable <- function(x) {
  x <- paste(as.character(x), collapse = "\n")
  
  pattern <- "\\\\begin\\{tabular\\}(\\[[^]]*\\])?\\{([^\\r\\n]*)\\}"
  
  if (!grepl(pattern, x, perl = TRUE)) {
    stop("No standard tabular environment found.")
  }
  
  x <- sub(
    pattern,
    "\\\\begin{autotabular}\\1{\\2}",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  
  sub(
    "\\end{tabular}",
    "\\end{autotabular}",
    x,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r}
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  descriptivesTableLatex <- descriptivesTableLatex %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -1,
        \(x) vapply(as.character(x), toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )

  descriptivesKable <- descriptivesTableLatex %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Variable", "$M$", "$SD$", "$M$", "$SD$"),
      align = c("l", rep("c", 4))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      header = c(" " = 1, "Female" = 2, "Male" = 2),
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(descriptivesTableLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(descriptivesKable),
    "../Tables/descriptivesTable.tex"
  )

}
```

## CFA

### Fix measurement functions

```{r}

fixedSingleFun <- function(i, parameterTable, digits=10) {
  
  par <- round(parameterTable[i,"est"], digits = digits)
  lhs <- parameterTable[i, "lhs"]
  rhs <- parameterTable[i, "rhs"]
  op  <- parameterTable[i, "op"]
  
  if (parameterTable[i,"op"] == "~1") {
    string <- paste(lhs, "~", par, "*", 1)
    return(string)
  } else {
    string <- paste(lhs, op, par, "*", rhs)
    return(string)
  }
}

fixedMultiFun <- function(i, parameterTable, digits=10) {
  
  par1 <- round(parameterTable[i, "est1"], digits = digits)
  par2 <- round(parameterTable[i, "est2"], digits = digits)
  lhs <- parameterTable[i, "lhs"]
  rhs <- parameterTable[i, "rhs"]
  op  <- parameterTable[i, "op"]
  
  if (op == "~1") {
    return(paste0(lhs, " ~ c(", par1, ", ", par2, ")*1"))
  } else {
    return(paste0(lhs, " ", op, " c(", par1, ", ", par2, ")*", rhs))
  }
}

extraMeasurementFun <- function(lvNames, covariates, group, data) {
  
  extraMeasurement <- paste(
    c(
      paste0(
        lvNames, " ~~ ",
        paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),
        " \n "
      ),
      if (length(covariates) > 1L) {
        paste0(
          covariates[-length(covariates)], " ~~ ",
          sapply(
            seq_len(length(covariates) - 1L),
            function(i) {
              paste(
                covariates[(i + 1L):length(covariates)],
                collapse = " + "
              )
            }
          ),
          " \n "
        )
      }
    ),
    collapse = ""
  )
  
  if(is.null(group)){
    # Fix mean of binary variable for convergence, cannot estimate both mean and var
    binaryString <- paste("Male", "~", mean(data$Male), "*", 1)
  } else {
    binaryString <- NULL
  }
  
  return(paste(extraMeasurement, binaryString, sep=" \n "))
}

congenialFun <- function(measurementFit, covariates=NULL, group=NULL, groupLabels=NULL, data) {
  
  if (inherits(measurementFit, "lavaan")) {
    measurementFit <- list(measurementFit)
  }

  parameterTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(measurementFit, parameterEstimates)
  )
  
  lvNames <- unique(unlist(
    lapply(measurementFit, lavNames, type = "lv")
  ))
  
  if(is.null(group)) {
    fixedMeasurementBlock <- sapply(
      X = 1:nrow(parameterTable),
      FUN = fixedSingleFun,
      parameterTable = parameterTable,
      digits=10
    ) %>%
      paste(collapse = " \n ")  
  } else {
    parameterTable <- parameterTable %>%
      dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, group, est) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(lhs, op, rhs),
        names_from = group,
        values_from = est,
        names_prefix = "est"
      )
    fixedMeasurementBlock <- sapply(
      X = 1:nrow(parameterTable),
      FUN = fixedMultiFun,
      parameterTable = parameterTable,
      digits=10
    ) %>%
      paste(collapse = " \n ")  
  }
  
  expandedModel <- fixedMeasurementBlock
  
  if (length(covariates) > 0L) {
    expandedModel <- paste(
      expandedModel,
      extraMeasurementFun(lvNames, covariates, group, data),
      sep = "\n"
    )
  }
  
  congenialFit <- cfa(
    expandedModel,  
    estimator = "ML",
    se = "none",
    test = "none",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = FALSE,
    group = group,
    group.label = groupLabels,
    data = data
  )

}
```

### Response

```{r}

set.seed(masterSeed)

responseMeasurement <- paste(
  'Physical =~ ', paste(physicalItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Verbal =~ ', paste(verbalItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Hostility =~ ', paste(hostilityItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Anger =~ ', paste(angerItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n '
)

responseFit <- cfa(
  responseMeasurement,
  estimator = "MLR",
  std.lv = TRUE,
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  data = replicationData
)

responseAlphaReliability <- compRelSEM(
  responseFit,
  obs.var = TRUE,
  tau.eq = TRUE
)

responseOmegaReliability <- compRelSEM(
  responseFit,
  obs.var = TRUE,
  tau.eq = FALSE
)

unlist(responseAlphaReliability)
unlist(responseOmegaReliability)

summary(responseFit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# -------------------------- RELIABILITY ADJUSTMENT -------------------------------
# Makes effects defined with respect to the true score variance of the response

replicationData$PhysicalSumScore <- as.numeric(scale(replicationData$PhysicalSumScore)) / sqrt(responseOmegaReliability$Physical[[1]])
replicationData$VerbalSumScore <- as.numeric(scale(replicationData$VerbalSumScore)) / sqrt(responseOmegaReliability$Verbal[[1]])
replicationData$HostilitySumScore <- as.numeric(scale(replicationData$HostilitySumScore)) / sqrt(responseOmegaReliability$Hostility[[1]])
replicationData$AngerSumScore <- as.numeric(scale(replicationData$AngerSumScore)) / sqrt(responseOmegaReliability$Anger[[1]])
```

```{r}
)

)

# -------------------------- RELIABILITY ADJUSTMENT -------------------------------

replicationData$PsychopathySumScore <- as.numeric(scale(replicationData$PsychopathySumScore)) / sqrt(predictorOmegaReliability$Psychopathy[[1]])
replicationData$NarcissismSumScore <- as.numeric(scale(replicationData$NarcissismSumScore)) / sqrt(predictorOmegaReliability$Narcissism[[1]])
```

#### Bifactor (S-1)

- Eid, M., Geiser, C., Koch, T., & Heene, M. (2017). Anomalous results in *G*-factor models: Explanations and alternatives. *Psychological Methods, 22*(3), 541–562. [https://doi.org/10.1037/met0000083](https://psycnet.apa.org/doi/10.1037/met0000083)

```{r}

set.seed(masterSeed)

bifactorMeasurement <- paste(
  'Reference =~ ', paste(coreItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Psychopathy =~ ', paste(psychopathyItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Narcissism =~ ', paste(narcissismItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Psychopathy ~~ 0*Reference \n ',
  'Narcissism ~~ 0*Reference \n '
)

bifactorFit <- cfa(
  bifactorMeasurement,  
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  std.lv = TRUE,
  data = replicationData
)

reliability <- compRelSEM(
  bifactorFit,
  obs.var = TRUE,
  tau.eq = FALSE
)

unlist(reliability)

summary(bifactorFit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

### Diagnostics

#### Invariance

##### Regularized BPAQ

```{r}

if(runRegularization) {
  
  set.seed(masterSeed)
  
  itemsBPAQ <- c(physicalItems, verbalItems, hostilityItems, angerItems)
  
  interceptsFemale <- paste0(
    itemsBPAQ, "_SEP_Int_SEP_none_SEP_Female"
  )
  
  interceptsMale <- gsub(
    "Female", "Male", interceptsFemale, fixed = TRUE
  )
  
  interceptsDelta <- gsub(
    "Female", "Delta", interceptsFemale, fixed = TRUE
  )
  
  residualsFemale <- paste0(
    itemsBPAQ, "_SEP_Var_SEP_", itemsBPAQ, "_SEP_Female"
  )
  
  lvNames <- lavNames(responseFit, "lv")
  
  latentCovFemale <- paste0(
    unlist(
      lapply(
        seq_along(lvNames),
        function(i) {
          rhs <- lvNames[i:length(lvNames)]
          
          paste0(
            lvNames[[i]], " ~~ ",
            lvNames[[i]], "_SEP_Var_SEP_", rhs, "_SEP_Female*",
            rhs, "\n"
          )
        }
      )
    ),
    collapse = ""
  )
  
  responseMeasurementFemale <- paste(
    "Physical =~",
    paste0(
      "Physical_SEP_Lam_SEP_", physicalItems, "_SEP_Both*",
      physicalItems,
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    "\n Verbal =~",
    paste0(
      "Verbal_SEP_Lam_SEP_", verbalItems, "_SEP_Both*",
      verbalItems,
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    "\n Hostility =~",
    paste0(
      "Hostility_SEP_Lam_SEP_", hostilityItems, "_SEP_Both*",
      hostilityItems,
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    "\n Anger =~",
    paste0(
      "Anger_SEP_Lam_SEP_", angerItems, "_SEP_Both*",
      angerItems,
      collapse = " + "
    ),
    "\n",
    paste0(
      itemsBPAQ, " ~ ", interceptsFemale, "*1",
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n",
    paste0(
      itemsBPAQ, " ~~ ", residualsFemale, "*", itemsBPAQ,
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n",
    latentCovFemale
  )
  
  meansMale <- paste0(
    lvNames, "_SEP_Int_SEP_none_SEP_Male"
  )
  
  latentMeansMale <- paste0(
    lvNames, " ~ ", meansMale, "*1",
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  
  responseMeasurementMale <- gsub(
    "Female",
    "Male",
    responseMeasurementFemale,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  
  responseMeasurementMale <- paste0(
    responseMeasurementMale, "\n",
    latentMeansMale
  )
  
  # Female reference: latent variances = 1, latent means = 0
  singleGroupFemaleBPAQ <- cfa(
    responseMeasurementFemale,
    estimator = "MLR",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = TRUE,
    data = replicationData[replicationData$Male == 0, ]
  )
  
  # Male: free latent variances, means, and all loadings
  singleGroupMaleBPAQ <- cfa(
    responseMeasurementMale,
    estimator = "MLR",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = FALSE,
    auto.fix.first = FALSE,
    do.fit = FALSE,
    data = replicationData[replicationData$Male == 1, ]
  )
  
  transformation <- paste0(
    "parameters: ",
    paste(
      c(interceptsMale, interceptsFemale, interceptsDelta),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n",
    paste0(
      interceptsMale, " = ",
      interceptsFemale, " + ",
      interceptsDelta, ";",
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
  
  tauDif <- 0.20
  nObs <- nobs(singleGroupFemaleBPAQ) + nobs(singleGroupMaleBPAQ)
  
  lambda <- 1 / (nObs * tauDif^2)
  
  lassoFitBPAQ <- lessSEM::lasso(
    lavaanModel = c(singleGroupFemaleBPAQ, singleGroupMaleBPAQ),
    regularized = interceptsDelta,
    lambdas = lambda,
    modifyModel = lessSEM::modifyModel(
      transformations = transformation
    )
  )
  
  lassoTableBPAQ <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lassoFitBPAQ@parameters %>%
      dplyr::select(-lambda, -alpha),
    
    lassoFitBPAQ@transformations %>%
      dplyr::select(-lambda, -alpha)
  ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "Parameter",
      values_to = "est",
      values_drop_na = TRUE
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
      Parameter,
      delim = "_SEP_",
      names = c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "group")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(group != "Delta") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      op = dplyr::recode(
        op,
        Lam = "=~",
        Var = "~~",
        Int = "~1"
      ),
      rhs = dplyr::if_else(rhs == "none", "", rhs),
      group = dplyr::if_else(
        group == "Both",
        "Female,Male",
        group
      )
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(group, delim = ",") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = dplyr::recode(group, Female = 1L, Male = 2L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      parTable(singleGroupFemaleBPAQ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          free == 0,
          lhs %in% lvNames,
          (op == "~~" & lhs == rhs) | op == "~1"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          lhs,
          op,
          rhs,
          group = 1L,
          est = ustart
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      group,
      match(op, c("=~", "~1", "~~")),
      lhs,
      rhs
    )
  
  interceptsBPAQ <- lassoTableBPAQ %>%
    filter(
      op == "~1" & lhs %in% lavNames(singleGroupFemaleBPAQ, "ov.ind")
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(lhs, op),
      names_from = group,
      values_from = est,
      names_prefix = "est"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      dif = abs(est2 - est1),
      factor = case_when(
        lhs %in% physicalItems ~ "Physical",
        lhs %in% verbalItems ~ "Verbal",
        lhs %in% hostilityItems ~ "Hostility",
        lhs %in% angerItems ~ "Anger"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(dif))
  
  saveRDS(interceptsBPAQ, file = "../Data/interceptsBPAQ.rds")
}
```

```{r}
if(runRegularization) {

    std.lv = FALSE,
    auto.fix.first = FALSE,
    do.fit = FALSE,

  )
  
  transformation <- paste0(
    "parameters: ",
    paste(
      c(interceptsMale, interceptsFemale, interceptsDelta),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n",
    paste0(
      interceptsMale, " = ",
      interceptsFemale, " + ",
      interceptsDelta, ";",
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
  
  tauDif <- 0.20
  nObs <- nobs(singleGroupFemaleSD3) + nobs(singleGroupMaleSD3)
  
  lambda <- 1 / (nObs * tauDif^2)
  
  lassoFitSD3 <- lessSEM::lasso(
    lavaanModel = c(singleGroupFemaleSD3, singleGroupMaleSD3),
    regularized = interceptsDelta,
    lambdas = lambda,
    modifyModel = lessSEM::modifyModel(
      transformations = transformation
    )
  )
  
  lassoTableSD3 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lassoFitSD3@parameters %>%
      dplyr::select(-lambda, -alpha),
    
    lassoFitSD3@transformations %>%
      dplyr::select(-lambda, -alpha)
  ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "Parameter",
      values_to = "est",
      values_drop_na = TRUE
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
      Parameter,
      delim = "_SEP_",
      names = c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "group")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(group != "Delta") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      op = dplyr::recode(
        op,
        Lam = "=~",
        Var = "~~",
        Int = "~1"
      ),
      rhs = dplyr::if_else(rhs == "none", "", rhs),
      group = dplyr::if_else(
        group == "Both",
        "Female,Male",
        group
      )
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(group, delim = ",") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = dplyr::recode(group, Female = 1L, Male = 2L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      parTable(singleGroupFemaleSD3) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          free == 0,
          lhs %in% lvNames,
          (op == "~~" & lhs == rhs) | op == "~1"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          lhs,
          op,
          rhs,
          group = 1L,
          est = ustart
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      group,
      match(op, c("=~", "~1", "~~")),
      lhs,

    )
  
  
  interceptsSD3 <- lassoTableSD3 %>%
    filter(
      op == "~1" & lhs %in% lavNames(singleGroupFemaleSD3, "ov.ind")
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(lhs, op),

      )

  saveRDS(interceptsSD3, file = "../Data/interceptsSD3.rds")
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(masterSeed)

interceptsBPAQ <- readRDS(file = "../Data/interceptsBPAQ.rds")

nullFitSD3 <- cfa(
  nullMeasurement,  
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  group = "Male",   
  group.label = c("0", "1"),
  group.equal = c("intercepts", "residuals"),
  auto.cov.y = FALSE,
  auto.var = TRUE,
  data = replicationData
)
```

##### LaTeX

```{r}

if (export) {
  
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  invarianceTableLatex <- invarianceTable %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Model, Panel),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  panelSizes <- table(invarianceTable$Panel)
  
  nBPAQ <- unname(panelSizes["BPAQ"])
  nSD3  <- unname(panelSizes["SD3"])
  
  invarianceKable <- invarianceTableLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Model,
      cfi.robust, delta_cfi.robust,
      rmsea.robust, delta_rmsea.robust,
      srmr, delta_srmr
    ) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 6)),
      col.names = c(
        "BPAQ",
        "CFI", "\\Delta CFI",
        "RMSEA", "\\Delta RMSEA",
        "SRMR", "\\Delta SRMR"
      )
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "SD3",
      start_row = nBPAQ + 1,
      end_row = nBPAQ + nSD3,
      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(invarianceTable) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
```

#### Residual covariances

```{r}

set.seed(masterSeed)

psychopathyMeasurement <- paste(
  'Reference =~ ', paste(coreItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Machiavellianism =~ ', paste(machiavellianismItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Narcissism =~ ', paste(narcissismItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Machiavellianism ~~ 0*Reference \n ',
  'Narcissism ~~ 0*Reference \n '
)

psychopathyFit <- cfa(
  psychopathyMeasurement,  
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  std.lv = TRUE,
  data = replicationData
)

narcissismMeasurement <- paste(
  'Reference =~ ', paste(coreItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Machiavellianism =~ ', paste(machiavellianismItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Psychopathy =~ ', paste(psychopathyItems, collapse = " + "), ' \n ',
  'Machiavellianism ~~ 0*Reference \n ',
  'Psychopathy ~~ 0*Reference \n '
)

narcissismFit <- cfa(
  narcissismMeasurement,  
  estimator = "MLR",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  std.lv = TRUE,
  data = replicationData
)

machiavellianismTable <- standardizedSolution(bifactorFit)

machiavellianismTable$reference <- "Mach"

psychopathyTable <- standardizedSolution(psychopathyFit)

psychopathyTable$reference <- "Psych"

narcissismTable <- standardizedSolution(narcissismFit)

narcissismTable$reference <- "Narc"

covarianceTable <- rbind(machiavellianismTable, psychopathyTable, narcissismTable)

covarianceTable <- covarianceTable %>%
  mutate(
    lhs = recode(
      lhs, 
      "Reference" = "Ref", 
      "Machiavellianism" = "Mach",
      "Psychopathy" = "Psych",
      "Narcissism" = "Narc"
    ),
    rhs = recode(
      rhs, 
      "Reference" = "Ref", 
      "Machiavellianism" = "Mach",
      "Psychopathy" = "Psych",
      "Narcissism" = "Narc"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (lhs %in% c("Psych", "Mach", "Narc")) &
      (op == "~~") & 
      (rhs %in% c("Psych", "Mach", "Narc")) 
      & lhs != rhs
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      pvalue <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      pvalue <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      pvalue <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      pvalue < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", pvalue)))
    ),
    Estimate = sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        est.std, stars, se, pFormatted
    ),
    Term = paste0("Cor(", lhs, ", ", rhs, " | ", reference, ")")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Term, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Term,
    values_from = Estimate
  )

covarianceTable

rm(psychopathyFit)
rm(narcissismFit)
```

```{r}
if(export) {
    
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  covarianceTableLatex <- covarianceTable %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        everything(),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  tableNotes <- r"(Entries are standardized residual covariances (i.e., partial correlations) from the bifactor ($\\mathrm{S}-1$) measurement model under alternative reference facets, with standard errors in parentheses. Mach = Machiavellianism; Psych = Psychopathy; Narc = Narcissism. The factor following the vertical bar corresponds to the bifactor reference facet. Models were estimated by robust maximum likelihood. * p < .05; ** p < .01; *** p < .001.)"
  
  covarianceKable <- covarianceTableLatex %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = rep("c", 3)
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
```

## Confirmatory models

### Fit functions

#### Checks

```{r}

checkConvergence <- function(fit) {
  isTRUE(lavInspect(fit, "converged")) &&
    isTRUE(lavInspect(fit, "post.check"))
}

checkPD <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch({
    acovs <- attr(
      lavPredict(fit, acov = "standard"),
      "acov"
    )
    
    if (is.null(acovs) || length(acovs) == 0L) return(FALSE)
    
    all(vapply(acovs, function(acov) {
      if (!is.matrix(acov) || any(!is.finite(acov))) return(FALSE)
      chol(acov)
      TRUE
    }, logical(1)))
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
}

checkFactorAlignment <- function(fullFit, bootFit) {
  
  lambdaFull <- lavInspect(fullFit, "est")[[1L]]$lambda
  lambdaBoot <- lavInspect(bootFit, "est")[[1L]]$lambda
  
  if (!setequal(rownames(lambdaFull), rownames(lambdaBoot)) ||
      !setequal(colnames(lambdaFull), colnames(lambdaBoot))) {
    stop("The fits do not contain the same items and factors.")
  }
  
  lambdaBoot <- lambdaBoot[
    rownames(lambdaFull),
    colnames(lambdaFull),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  numerator <- colSums(lambdaFull * lambdaBoot)
  denominator <- sqrt(colSums(lambdaFull^2) * colSums(lambdaBoot^2))
  
  if (any(!is.finite(denominator) | denominator == 0)) {
    stop("Cannot calculate a cosine for a zero-length loading vector.")
  }
  
  numerator / denominator
}
```

#### VWLE fun

```{r}

vwleFun <- function(response, g, s, covariates, lambdaMatrix, covMatrix, coefMatrix, stdVec=NULL) {
  
  # Function assumes matrices are properly ordered for multiplication downstream
  
  gBase <- unique(sub(":.*$", "", g)) #No interaction terms
  
  # ----------------- REDUCED FORM COVARIANCES -----------------------
  
  
  phi_g <- covMatrix[rownames(covMatrix) %in% g, colnames(covMatrix) %in% g, drop=FALSE]
  
  phi_s <- covMatrix[rownames(covMatrix) %in% c(unlist(s), covariates), colnames(covMatrix) %in% c(unlist(s), covariates), drop=FALSE]
  
  phi_gs <- covMatrix[rownames(covMatrix) %in% g, colnames(covMatrix) %in% c(unlist(s), covariates), drop=FALSE]
  
  # ----------------- LOADINGS -----------------------
  
  lambda_x <- lambdaMatrix[, !(colnames(lambdaMatrix) %in% gBase), drop = FALSE]
  
  lambda_x_xi <- lambdaMatrix[, gBase, drop = FALSE]
  
  lambda_xi <- solve(t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x) %*% t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x_xi

  # Match second order loadings to corresponding columns in the phi_s matrix. We assume the latent manifest interactions have the same loading that the latent variable alone, on the grounds of no cross products: 
  # xi =  lambda * xi_g + xi_s --> xi * m = lambda * xi_g * m + xi_s * m
  
  loadings <- sapply(
    colnames(phi_s), 
    FUN = function(x) {
      base <- sub(":.*$", "", x)
      if(base %in% rownames(lambda_xi)) {
        return(lambda_xi[base,])
      } else {
        return(0)
      }
    }
  )
  
  lambda_xi <- matrix(
    data=rep(loadings, times=ncol(phi_g)), 
    nrow=nrow(phi_s), 
    ncol=ncol(phi_g),
    dimnames = list(rownames(phi_s), colnames(phi_g))
  )
  
  lambda_xi[
    outer(
      sub("^[^:]+", "", rownames(lambda_xi)),
      sub("^[^:]+", "", colnames(lambda_xi)),
      `!=`
    )
  ] <- 0
  
  # Make first order loading matrix consistent with post-measurement standardization 
  if (!is.null(stdVec)) {
    
    unscaled <- setdiff(covariates, names(stdVec))
    stdVec[unscaled] <- 1
    
    rowSD <- stdVec[sub(":.*$", "", rownames(lambda_xi))]
    colSD <- stdVec[sub(":.*$", "", colnames(lambda_xi))]
    
    D_s <- diag(rowSD, nrow = length(rowSD))
    D_g <- diag(colSD, nrow = length(colSD))
    
    dimnames(D_s) <- list(rownames(lambda_xi), rownames(lambda_xi))
    dimnames(D_g) <- list(colnames(lambda_xi), colnames(lambda_xi))
    
    lambda_xi <- solve(D_s) %*% lambda_xi %*% D_g
  }
  
  # ----------------- FIRST ORDER COVARIANCES -----------------------
  
  firstTerm <- lambda_xi %*% phi_g %*% t(lambda_xi)
  
  secondTerm <- lambda_xi %*% phi_gs
  
  thirdTerm <- t(phi_gs) %*% t(lambda_xi)
  
  phi_1 <- firstTerm + secondTerm + thirdTerm + phi_s
  
  # ----------------- COEFFICIENTS -----------------------
  
  gamma <- coefMatrix[rownames(coefMatrix) %in% response, colnames(coefMatrix) %in% c(g, unlist(s), covariates), drop = FALSE]
  
  gamma_g <- gamma[, colnames(gamma) %in% g, drop = FALSE]
  
  gamma_s <- gamma[, colnames(gamma) %in% c(unlist(s), covariates), drop = FALSE]
  
  
  # ----------------- ESTIMATOR -----------------------

  cov_eta_xi <- 
    gamma_g %*% (phi_g %*% t(lambda_xi) + phi_gs) +
    gamma_s %*% (t(phi_gs) %*% t(lambda_xi) + phi_s)
  
  phi <- covMatrix[rownames(covMatrix) %in% c(g, unlist(s), covariates), colnames(covMatrix) %in% c(g, unlist(s), covariates), drop = FALSE]
  
  cov_eta_reduced <- gamma %*% phi
  
  vwle <- do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(
      X = unique(sub(":.*$", "", unlist(s))),
      FUN = function(i) {
        
        s_j <- unlist(s)[sub(":.*$", "", unlist(s)) == i]
        
        g_i <- g[vapply(
          s,
          function(x) any(x %in% s_j),
          logical(1)
        )]
        
        vwle_j <- do.call(
          rbind,
          lapply(
            seq_len(nrow(gamma)),
            function(r) {
              
              minj <-
                !(colnames(phi) %in% c(g_i, s_j)) &
                gamma[r, colnames(phi)] != 0
              
              cov_j <- cov_eta_xi[r, s_j, drop = FALSE]
              
              var_j <- phi_1[s_j, s_j, drop = FALSE]
              
              if (!any(minj)) {
                return(cov_j %*% solve(var_j))
              }
              
              cov_minj <- cov_eta_reduced[r, minj, drop = FALSE]
              
              var_minj <- phi[minj, minj, drop = FALSE]
              
              prec_minj <- solve(var_minj)
              
              cov_j_minj <-
                phi[s_j, minj, drop = FALSE] +
                lambda_xi[s_j, g_i, drop = FALSE] %*%
                phi[g_i, minj, drop = FALSE]
              
              (cov_j - cov_minj %*% prec_minj %*% t(cov_j_minj)) %*%
                solve(var_j - cov_j_minj %*% prec_minj %*% t(cov_j_minj))
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
  
  vwle <- vwle[, unlist(s), drop = FALSE]
  
  vwle_std <- do.call(
    rbind, 
    lapply(
      X=1:nrow(vwle), 
      FUN=function(i){
        vwle[i,] * sqrt(diag(phi_1))[sub(":.*$", "", unlist(s))]
      }
    )
  )
  
  rownames(vwle_std) <- rownames(vwle)
  
  if (!is.null(stdVec)) {
    vwle <- vwle %*% solve(
      D_s[colnames(vwle), colnames(vwle), drop = FALSE]
    )
  }
  
  return(list(lvl = vwle, std = vwle_std))
}
```

#### Full fun

```{r}

effectSizesFun <- function(structuralFit) {
  
  responseNames <- lavNames(structuralFit, "ov.y")
  
  predictorNames <- lavNames(structuralFit, "ov.x")
  
  coefMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "est")$beta[responseNames, predictorNames, drop=FALSE])
  
  responseVar <- diag(as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all"))[responseNames, responseNames, drop=FALSE])
  
  predictorMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all"))[predictorNames, predictorNames, drop=FALSE]
  
  
  etaSemi <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      1:nrow(coefMatrix),
      function(i) {
        betas <- coefMatrix[i, , drop=TRUE]
        mask <- betas != 0
        
        etaSemi <- coefMatrix[i, , drop=FALSE]
        if (!any(mask)) return(etaSemi)
        
        etaSemi[mask] <- betas[mask]^2 / 
          (responseVar[i] * diag(solve(predictorMatrix[mask, mask, drop=FALSE])))
        
        return(etaSemi)
      }
    )
  )
  
}

rSquaredFun <- function(structuralFit) {
  
  responseNames <- lavNames(structuralFit, "ov.y")
  predictorNames <- lavNames(structuralFit, "ov.x")
  
  coefMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "est")$beta[responseNames, predictorNames, drop=FALSE])
  responseMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all"))[responseNames, responseNames, drop=FALSE]
  predictorMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all"))[predictorNames, predictorNames, drop=FALSE]
  
  stdMatrix <- 
    diag(1 / sqrt(diag(responseMatrix)), nrow = length(responseNames)) %*% 
    coefMatrix %*% 
    diag(sqrt(diag(predictorMatrix)), nrow = length(predictorNames))
  
  rownames(stdMatrix) <- responseNames
  colnames(stdMatrix) <- predictorNames
  
  corMatrix <- cov2cor(as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all")))[responseNames, predictorNames, drop=FALSE]
  
  return(list(corMatrix=corMatrix, stdMatrix=stdMatrix))
}

plausibleFun <- function(draw, structuralModel, measurementFit, VWLE=FALSE, g, s, covariatesVWLE, fullSample = TRUE, data, masterSeed) {
  
  set.seed(masterSeed + draw)

  PVs <- plausibleValues(
    measurementFit,
    nDraws = 1,
    seed = masterSeed + draw,
    method = "Regression"
  )[[1]]
  
  caseIdx <- PVs$case.idx
  
  stdVec <- vapply(PVs, sd, numeric(1))
  
  PVs <- PVs %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(lavNames(measurementFit, "lv"))) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        everything(),
        ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))
      )
    )
  
  df <- cbind(data[caseIdx, , drop = FALSE], PVs)
  
  structuralFit <- sem(
    model=structuralModel,
    estimator="MLR",
    meanstructure=TRUE,
    data = df
  )
  
  if (!checkConvergence(structuralFit)) return(NULL)
  
  response <- c(
    lavNames(structuralFit, type = "ov.y"),
    lavNames(structuralFit, type = "lv.y")
  )
  
  # ------------------------VWLE START-----------------------------
  
  if(VWLE) {
    
    coefMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "est")$beta)[response, ] #Ensure response order
    
    order <- colnames(coefMatrix) #Define predictor order
    
    covMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all"))
    
    covMatrix <- covMatrix[order, order, drop=FALSE]
    
    # Loadings are assumed fixed (conditioned on) for the two stage estimation procedure
    lambdaMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(measurementFit, "est")$`0`$lambda)[lavNames(measurementFit, type="ov.ind"), lavNames(measurementFit, type="lv")]
    
    vwleResult <- vwleFun(
      response=response, 
      g=g, 
      s=s, 
      covariates=covariatesVWLE, 
      lambdaMatrix=lambdaMatrix,
      covMatrix=covMatrix,
      coefMatrix=coefMatrix,
      stdVec=stdVec
    )
    
    vwleList <- lapply(
      seq_len(nrow(vwleResult$std)), 
      function(i) {
        out <- lapply(
          seq_len(ncol(vwleResult$std)), 
          function(j){
            return(vwleResult$std[i,j, drop=FALSE])
          }
        )
        return(out)
      }
    )
    
    vwleList <- unlist(vwleList, recursive=FALSE)
    
    vwleRows <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(
        vwleList,
        function(i) {
          left <- rownames(i)
          right <- colnames(i)
          
          target <- coefMatrix[left, right]
          
          if(target == 0) {
            # Do not extract the VWLE if a specific component is absent from the corresponding equation, otherwise the result corresponds to the general component translation into first-order coordinates, which is incomplete for the measured construct.
            return(NULL)
          } else {
            vwleRows <- tibble::tibble(
              lhs = left,
              op = "~",
              rhs = paste0(right, "VWLE"),
              est = as.numeric(i)
            )
            return(vwleRows)
          }
        }
      )
    )
    
  } else {
    vwleRows <- NULL
  }
  
  # ------------------------VWLE END-----------------------------
  
  if(fullSample) {
    
    effectSizes <- effectSizesFun(structuralFit)
    r2Matrices <- rSquaredFun(structuralFit)
    
    estimates <- parameterEstimates(structuralFit) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        etaSemi = ifelse(
          op == "~" && lhs %in% response,
          effectSizes[lhs, rhs, drop=TRUE],
          NA
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    nobs <- lavInspect(structuralFit, "nobs")
    
    nobsRows <- tibble::tibble(
      lhs = response,
      op = "gof",
      rhs = rep("N", times = length(response)),
      est = rep(nobs, length(response))
    )
    
    estimates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      estimates,
      vwleRows,
      nobsRows
    )
    
  } else {
    
    estimates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      parameterEstimates(structuralFit),
      vwleRows
    ) %>%
      mutate(etaSemi = NA_real_)
    
    r2Matrices <- NULL
    
  }
  
  return(list(estimates=estimates, r2Matrices=r2Matrices))
  
}


# -------------------------------- PROCESS RESULTS ------------------------------------

processFunPV <- function(structuralFit) {
  
  structuralFit <- Filter(Negate(is.null), structuralFit)
  
  if (length(structuralFit) == 0L) {
    stop("No successful PV fits.")
  }
  
  estimates <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      seq_along(structuralFit),
      function(i) {
        structuralFit[[i]][["estimates"]]
      }
    )
  )
  
  if(!is.null(structuralFit[[1]][["r2Matrices"]])) {
    pooledCorMatrix <- Reduce(
      "+",
      lapply(
        seq_along(structuralFit),
        function(i) {
          structuralFit[[i]][["r2Matrices"]][["corMatrix"]]
        }
      )
    ) / length(structuralFit)
    
    pooledStdMatrix <- Reduce(
      "+",
      lapply(
        seq_along(structuralFit),
        function(i) {
          structuralFit[[i]][["r2Matrices"]][["stdMatrix"]]
        }
      )
    ) / length(structuralFit)
    
    r2 <- rowSums(pooledCorMatrix * pooledStdMatrix)
    
    r2Rows <- tibble::tibble(
      lhs = names(r2),
      op = "gof",
      rhs = rep("R2", times = length(r2)),
      Estimate = as.numeric(r2)
    )
  } else {
    r2Rows <- NULL
  }

  
  processed <- estimates %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(est),
      !is.na(se) | op == "gof" | endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")
    ) %>%
    group_by(lhs, op, rhs) %>%
    summarise(
      M = n(),
      Eta2 = mean(etaSemi),
      Estimate = mean(est, na.rm=TRUE),
      WithinVar = mean(se^2, na.rm=TRUE),
      BetweenVar = var(est, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TotalVar = WithinVar + (1 + 1/M) * BetweenVar,
      SE = ifelse(op %in% c("~", "~1", ":=") & !(endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")), sqrt(TotalVar), NA),
      Z = ifelse(op %in% c("~", "~1", ":=") & !(endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")), Estimate / SE, NA),
      P = ifelse(op %in% c("~", "~1", ":=") & !(endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")), 2 * pnorm(abs(Z), lower.tail = FALSE), NA)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(r2Rows)
  
  return(processed)
  
}
```

#### Bootstrap fun

```{r}

bootFun <- function(draw, mDraws, structuralModel, measurementModel, fullMeasurement, VWLE=FALSE, g, s, covariatesVWLE, congenialCovariates=c("Age"), group=NULL, groupLabels=NULL, invariance=NULL, groupFree=NULL, data, masterSeed) {
  
  bootSeed <- masterSeed + draw * (mDraws + 1L)
  
  set.seed(bootSeed)
  
  idx <- sample.int(nrow(data), size = nrow(data), replace = TRUE)
  
  dataBoot <- data[idx, ]
  
  measurementFit <- lapply(
    seq_along(measurementModel),
    function(i) {
      measurementFit <- cfa(
        measurementModel[[i]],
        estimator = "ML",
        se = "none",
        test = "none",
        baseline = FALSE,
        std.lv = TRUE,
        meanstructure = TRUE,
        group=group,
        group.label = groupLabels,
        group.equal=invariance[[i]],
        group.partial=paste0(groupFree[[i]], "~ 1"),
        data = dataBoot
      )
    }
  )
  
  if (!all(sapply(measurementFit, checkConvergence)) || !all(sapply(measurementFit, checkPD))) return(NULL)

  # ------------------- CONGENIAL START ---------------------------
  
  congenialFit <- congenialFun(
    measurementFit=measurementFit, 
    covariates=congenialCovariates,
    group=group,
    groupLabels = groupLabels,
    data=dataBoot
  )
  
  if (!checkConvergence(congenialFit) || !checkPD(congenialFit)) return(NULL)
  
  cosine <- checkFactorAlignment(fullFit = fullMeasurement, bootFit = congenialFit)
  reversedFactors <- names(cosine)[cosine < 0]
  
  # ------------------- CONGENIAL END ---------------------------

  estimates <- lapply(
    X = 1:mDraws,
    plausibleFun,
    structuralModel=structuralModel,
    measurementFit=congenialFit,
    VWLE=VWLE,
    g=g, 
    s=s,
    covariatesVWLE=covariatesVWLE,
    fullSample=FALSE,
    data=dataBoot,
    masterSeed = bootSeed
  )
  
  estimates <- Filter(Negate(is.null), estimates)
  if (length(estimates) == 0L) return(NULL)
  
  estimates <- estimates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(estimates, function(x) x[["estimates"]])
  ) %>%
    filter(
      op == "~" 
      | (op == "~1" & lhs %in% lavNames(lavaanify(structuralModel), type = "ov.y"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(ci.lower, ci.upper, pvalue)) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(est),
      !is.na(se) | endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")
    ) %>%
    # Flip signs of reversed factors
    dplyr::mutate(
      rhsFactor = sub(":Male$", "", sub("VWLE$", "", rhs)),
      lhsSign = if_else(lhs %in% reversedFactors, -1, 1),
      rhsSign = if_else(rhsFactor %in% reversedFactors, -1, 1),
      est = dplyr::case_when(
        op %in% c("~", "~~") ~ est * lhsSign * rhsSign,
        op == "~1"          ~ est * lhsSign,
        TRUE                ~ est
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-rhsFactor, -lhsSign, -rhsSign) %>%
    # Pool
    group_by(lhs, op, rhs) %>%
    summarise(
      M = n(),
      estBoot = mean(est),
      WithinVar = mean(se^2),
      BetweenVar = var(est),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TotalVar = WithinVar + (1 + 1/M) * BetweenVar, # Rubin MI total variance
      seBoot = sqrt(TotalVar)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, estBoot, seBoot)
  
  estimates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    estimates,
    tibble::tibble(
      lhs = names(cosine),
      op = "cosine",
      rhs = "",
      estBoot = unname(cosine),
      seBoot = NA_real_
    )
  )
  
  estimates$draw <- draw
  
  return(estimates)
}


# -------------------------------- PROCESS RESULTS ------------------------------------

processFunBoot <- function(fullFit, bootFit) {
  
  by <- join_by(lhs, op, rhs)
  
  vwleBoot <- fullFit %>%
    right_join(bootFit, by=by) %>%
    filter(endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")) %>%
    group_by(lhs, op, rhs) %>%
    summarise(
      M=first(M),
      Estimate=first(Estimate),
      WithinVar=first(WithinVar),
      BetweenVar=first(BetweenVar),
      TotalVar=first(TotalVar),
      SE = sd(estBoot, na.rm=TRUE),
      Z = Estimate / SE,
      P = 2 * pnorm(abs(Z), lower.tail = FALSE),
      pBoot = mean(
        abs(estBoot - Estimate) >= abs(Estimate),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      meanBoot = mean(estBoot, na.rm=TRUE),
      biasBoot = meanBoot - Estimate,
      bootSuccess = n_distinct(draw),
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  
  structuralBoot <- fullFit %>%
    dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, Estimate, Z) %>%
    right_join(bootFit, by=by) %>%
    filter(!endsWith(rhs, "VWLE"), op != "cosine") %>%
    group_by(lhs, op, rhs) %>%
    mutate(
      zBoot = (estBoot - Estimate) / seBoot,
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      pBoot = mean(
        abs(zBoot) >= abs(first(Z)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      meanBoot = mean(estBoot, na.rm=TRUE),
      biasBoot = meanBoot - first(Estimate),
      bootSuccess = n_distinct(draw),
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  jointFit <- fullFit %>%
    filter(!endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")) %>%
    left_join(structuralBoot, by = by) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(vwleBoot) %>%
    mutate(
      bootCount = attr(bootFit, "lastAttempt"),
      bootRate = bootSuccess / bootCount
    )
}
```

```{r}
    Difference = Estimate,
    SE = SE,
    Z = Z,
    P = P,
    Stars = case_when(
      P < .001 ~ "***",
      P < .01  ~ "**",
      P < .05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    Model = "Invariant",
    Scale = Scale,
    .keep = "none"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Variable, Eta2, Difference, SE, Z, P, Stars, Model, Scale
  )

invariantUnconditionalTests %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Eta2, Difference, SE, Z, P), \(x) round(x, digits = 3))
  )
```

#### Plot

```{r}

variableOrder <- c(
  "Physical",
  "Verbal",
  "Hostility",
  "Anger",
  "Machiavellianism",
  "Psychopathy",
  "Narcissism"
)

# 1. Manually compute the X-axis coordinates to force perfect clustering
plotDf <- dplyr::bind_rows(naiveUnconditionalMeans, invariantUnconditionalMeans) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = variableOrder),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Naive", "Invariant")),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    
    # Base integer position for the variable (1, 2, 3...)
    x_base = as.numeric(Variable),
    # Offset the Model: Naive shifts left, Invariant shifts right
    x_model = ifelse(Model == "Naive", -0.15, 0.15),
    # Offset the Sex within the Model cluster
    x_sex = ifelse(Sex == "Female", -0.05, 0.05),
    # Final coordinate
    x_pos = x_base + x_model + x_sex
  )

# 2. Compute coordinates for the significance markers so they align over their respective models
testsDf <- dplyr::bind_rows(naiveUnconditionalTests, invariantUnconditionalTests) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = variableOrder),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Naive", "Invariant")),
    x_base = as.numeric(Variable),
    x_model = ifelse(Model == "Naive", -0.15, 0.15),
    x_pos = x_base + x_model
  )

descriptivePlot <- ggplot(plotDf, aes(x=x_pos, y=Mean, color=Model, shape=Sex)) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey65",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = testsDf,
    aes(x = x_pos, y = max(plotDf$Upper, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1, label = Stars),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values  = c("Naive" = "lightcoral" , "Invariant" = "steelblue"),
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values  = c("Female" = 17, "Male" = 16),
  ) +
  # Map the numeric X-axis back to the variable names
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:length(variableOrder),
    labels = variableOrder
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Scale, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x=NULL, y="Standardized score") +
  theme_minimal(
    base_family = "serif",
    base_size = 10
  ) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 9,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 9,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

descriptivePlot

    plot = descriptivePlot,
    device = "pdf",
    width = 5.5,
    height = 3.6,
```

```{r}
baselineModel <- '
  Physical ~ Male + Reference + Psychopathy + Age
  Verbal ~ Male + Reference + Psychopathy + Age
  Hostility ~ Male + Reference + Narcissism + Age
  Anger ~ Male + Reference + Age
  
  Physical ~~ Verbal
  Physical ~~ Hostility
  Physical ~~ Anger
  Verbal ~~ Hostility
  Verbal ~~ Anger
  Hostility ~~ Anger
'

if (parallelSupported) {
  structuralFit <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
    X = 1:M,
    FUN = plausibleFun,
    structuralModel = baselineModel,

    VWLE=TRUE,
    g=c("Reference"),

    mc.cores = availableCores,

} else {

  )
}

baselineFit <- processFunPV(structuralFit)

baselineFit %>%
```

#### Bootstrap

```{r}

bootPath <- "../Data/baselineBoot.rds"

targetReached <- FALSE
restartLocal <- restartBootstraps

while (runBootstraps && !targetReached) {
  
  if(!restartLocal) {
    storedResults <- readRDS(bootPath)
    lastAttempt <- attr(storedResults, "lastAttempt")
    setStart <- lastAttempt + 1L
    remainingDraws <- B - n_distinct(storedResults$draw)
    setEnd <- setStart + remainingDraws - 1L
  } else {
    setStart <- 1
    setEnd <- B
  }
  
  targetReached <- setStart > setEnd
  
  if (!targetReached) {
    
    if (parallelSupported && setStart < setEnd) {
      structuralFit <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
        X = setStart:setEnd,
        FUN = bootFun,
        mDraws = MB,
        structuralModel = baselineModel, 
        measurementModel = list(responseMeasurement, bifactorMeasurement),
        fullMeasurement = congenialPartialFit,
        VWLE=TRUE,
        g=c("Reference"),
        s=list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism")),
        covariatesVWLE = c("Male", "Age"),
        group="Male",
        groupLabels = c("0", "1"),
        invariance = list(c("loadings", "intercepts"), c("loadings", "intercepts")),
        groupFree = list(freeBPAQ, freeSD3),
        data = replicationData,
        masterSeed = masterSeed,
        mc.cores = availableCores,
        mc.set.seed = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      structuralFit <- lapply(
        X = setStart:setEnd,
        FUN = bootFun,
        mDraws = MB,
        structuralModel = baselineModel, 
        measurementModel = list(responseMeasurement, bifactorMeasurement),
        fullMeasurement = congenialPartialFit,
        VWLE=TRUE,
        g=c("Reference"),
        s=list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism")),
        covariatesVWLE = c("Male", "Age"),
        group="Male",
        groupLabels = c("0", "1"),
        invariance = list(c("loadings", "intercepts"), c("loadings", "intercepts")),
        groupFree = list(freeBPAQ, freeSD3),
        data = replicationData,
        masterSeed = masterSeed
      )
    }
    
    if(!restartLocal) {
      structuralFit <- dplyr::bind_rows(storedResults, structuralFit)
      rm(storedResults)
    } else {
      structuralFit <- dplyr::bind_rows(structuralFit)
    }
    
    attr(structuralFit, "lastAttempt") <- setEnd
    
    saveRDS(structuralFit, bootPath)
    
    restartLocal <- FALSE
    
    rm(structuralFit)
  }
}
```

### Confirmatory table

#### HTML

```{r}

outcomeLevels <- c(
  "Physical",
  "Verbal",
  "Hostility",
  "Anger"
)

outcomeLabels <- c(
  "Physical (Z)",
  "Verbal (Z)",
  "Hostility (Z)",
  "Anger (Z)"
)

termLevels <- c(
  "Male",
  "Reference",
  "Reference:Male",
  "Psychopathy",
  "Psychopathy:Male",
  "Narcissism",
  "Age",
  "",
  "R2",
  "N"
)

termLabels <- c(
  "Male",
  "Reference (Z)",
  "Reference × Male",
  "Psychopathy (Z)",
  "Psychopathy × Male",
  "Narcissism (Z)",
  "Age",
  "Intercept",
  "R²",
  "N"
)

modelLevels <- c("baseline", "moderated")
modelLabels <- c("C1", "C2")

baselineBoot$model <- "baseline"
moderatedBoot$model <- "moderated"

confirmatoryTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(baselineBoot, moderatedBoot) %>%
  filter(op %in% c("~", "gof") | (lhs %in% outcomeLevels & op == "~1")) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      P < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P)))
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)",
        Estimate, stars, SE
      ),
      op %in% c("~", "~1") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      rhs == "N" ~ sprintf("%.0f", Estimate),
      .default = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate)
    ),
    Outcome = factor(
      lhs,
      levels = outcomeLevels,
      labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    Model = factor(
      model,
      levels = modelLevels,
      labels = modelLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      case_when(
        op %in% c("~", "~1") & !endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ "Structural",
        op %in% c("~", "~1") & endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ "VWLE",
        op == "gof" ~ "Model information",
        .default = ""
      ),
      levels = c("Structural", "VWLE", "Model information")
    ),
    Term = factor(
      sub("VWLE$", "", rhs), 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome,
    Term,
    Model,
    Estimate,
    Panel
  )

confirmatoryTableFull <- confirmatoryTable %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Panel, Term)

confirmatoryTableLean <- confirmatoryTable %>%
  filter(Outcome != "Anger (Z)") %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(!(Term %in% c("Age", "Intercept"))) %>%
  arrange(Panel, Term)

confirmatoryGT <- confirmatoryTableLean %>%
  gt::gt(
    rowname_col = "Term",
    groupname_col = "Panel"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Physical (Z)",

  ) %>%

    columns = -Term
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",

  ) %>%

    missing_text = "—"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(

    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(
      groups = everything()
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Verdana", "Arial", "sans-serif"),

    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(0),
```

#### LaTeX

```{r}

if(export) {
  
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------ LEAN TABLE ---------------------------------------
  
  confirmatoryTableLatex <- confirmatoryTableLean %>%
    mutate(
      Panel = as.character(Panel),
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "Reference × Male" = "Reference $\\times$ Male",
        "Psychopathy × Male" = "Psychopathy $\\times$ Male",
        "Narcissism × Male" = "Narcissism $\\times$ Male",
        "R²" = "$\\text{R}^2$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Panel, Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  
  # Determine panel positions automatically
  panelRuns <- rle(confirmatoryTableLatex$Panel)
  
  panelIndex <- stats::setNames(
    panelRuns$lengths,
    panelRuns$values
  )
  
  panelSizes <- table(confirmatoryTableLatex$Panel)
  
  nPredictors <- unname(panelSizes["Structural"])
  nVWLE <- unname(panelSizes["VWLE"])
  nModelInfo <- unname(panelSizes["Model information"])
  
  confirmatoryKable <- confirmatoryTableLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 6)),
      col.names = c("Structural", rep(c("C1", "C2"), 3))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(confirmatoryTableLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Physical (Z)" = 2,
        "Verbal (Z)" = 2,
        "Hostility (Z)" = 2
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "VWLE",
      start_row = nPredictors + 1,
      end_row = nPredictors + nVWLE,
      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "Model information",
      start_row = nPredictors + nVWLE + 1,
      end_row = nPredictors + nVWLE + nModelInfo,
      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(confirmatoryKable),
    "../Tables/confirmatoryTable.tex"
  )
  
  # ------------------------------------ FULL TABLE ---------------------------------------
  
  confirmatoryFullLatex <- confirmatoryTableFull %>%
    mutate(
      Panel = as.character(Panel),
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "Reference × Male" = "Reference $\\times$ Male",
        "Psychopathy × Male" = "Psychopathy $\\times$ Male",
        "Narcissism × Male" = "Narcissism $\\times$ Male",
        "R²" = "$\\text{R}^2$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Panel, Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  
  # Determine panel positions automatically
  panelRuns <- rle(confirmatoryFullLatex$Panel)
  
  panelIndex <- stats::setNames(
    panelRuns$lengths,
    panelRuns$values
  )
  
  panelSizes <- table(confirmatoryFullLatex$Panel)
  
  nPredictors <- unname(panelSizes["Structural"])

  nModelInfo <- unname(panelSizes["Model information"])
  
  confirmatoryFullKable <- confirmatoryFullLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,

      col.names = c("Structural", rep(c("C1", "C2"), 4))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(confirmatoryFullLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Physical (Z)" = 2,
        "Verbal (Z)" = 2,
        "Hostility (Z)" = 2,
        "Anger (Z)" = 2
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "VWLE",
      start_row = nPredictors + 1,

      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "Model information",
      start_row = nPredictors + nVWLE + 1,
      end_row = nPredictors + nVWLE + nModelInfo,
      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(confirmatoryFullKable),
    "../Tables/confirmatoryTableFull.tex"
  )
}
```

## Exploratory models

### Saturated model

```{r}

saturatedModel <- '
  Physical ~ Male + Reference + Psychopathy + Narcissism + Reference:Male + Psychopathy:Male + Narcissism:Male
  Verbal ~ Male + Reference + Psychopathy + Narcissism + Reference:Male + Psychopathy:Male + Narcissism:Male
  Hostility ~ Male + Reference + Psychopathy + Narcissism + Reference:Male + Psychopathy:Male + Narcissism:Male
  Anger ~ Male + Reference + Psychopathy + Narcissism + Reference:Male + Psychopathy:Male + Narcissism:Male
  
  Physical ~~ Verbal
  Physical ~~ Hostility
  Physical ~~ Anger
  Verbal ~~ Hostility
  Verbal ~~ Anger
  Hostility ~~ Anger
'

if (parallelSupported) {
  structuralFit <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
    X = 1:M,
    FUN = plausibleFun,
    structuralModel = saturatedModel, 
    measurementFit = congenialPartialFit,
    VWLE=TRUE,
    g=c("Reference", "Reference:Male"),
    s=list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism"), c("Psychopathy:Male", "Narcissism:Male")),
    covariatesVWLE = c("Male"),
    data = replicationData,
    masterSeed = masterSeed,
    mc.cores = availableCores,
    mc.set.seed = TRUE
  )
} else {
  structuralFit <- lapply(
    X = 1:M,
    FUN = plausibleFun,
    structuralModel = saturatedModel, 
    measurementFit = congenialPartialFit,
    VWLE=TRUE,
    g=c("Reference", "Reference:Male"),
    s=list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism"), c("Psychopathy:Male", "Narcissism:Male")),
    covariatesVWLE = c("Male"),
    data = replicationData,
    masterSeed = masterSeed
  )
}

saturatedFit <- processFunPV(structuralFit)

saturatedFit %>%
  filter(op %in% c("~", "gof") & !(rhs %in% c("N"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, rhs, Eta2, Estimate, SE, Z, P) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Eta2, Estimate, SE, Z, P), \(x) round(x, digits = 4))
  )
```

#### Bootstrap

```{r}

bootPath <- "../Data/saturatedBoot.rds"

targetReached <- FALSE
restartLocal <- restartBootstraps

while (runBootstraps && !targetReached) {
  
  if(!restartLocal) {
    storedResults <- readRDS(bootPath)
    lastAttempt <- attr(storedResults, "lastAttempt")
    setStart <- lastAttempt + 1L
    remainingDraws <- B - n_distinct(storedResults$draw)
    setEnd <- setStart + remainingDraws - 1L
  } else {
    setStart <- 1
    setEnd <- B
  }
  
  targetReached <- setStart > setEnd
  
  if (!targetReached) {
    
    if (parallelSupported && setStart < setEnd) {
      structuralFit <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
        X = setStart:setEnd,
        FUN = bootFun,
        mDraws = MB,
        structuralModel = saturatedModel, 
        measurementModel = list(responseMeasurement, bifactorMeasurement),
        fullMeasurement = congenialPartialFit,
        VWLE=TRUE,
        g=c("Reference", "Reference:Male"),
        s=list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism"), c("Psychopathy:Male", "Narcissism:Male")),
        covariatesVWLE = c("Male"),
        group="Male",
        groupLabels = c("0", "1"),
        invariance = list(c("loadings", "intercepts"), c("loadings", "intercepts")),
        groupFree = list(freeBPAQ, freeSD3),
        data = replicationData,
        masterSeed = masterSeed,
        mc.cores = availableCores,
        mc.set.seed = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      structuralFit <- lapply(
        X = setStart:setEnd,
        FUN = bootFun,
        mDraws = MB,
        structuralModel = saturatedModel, 
        measurementModel = list(responseMeasurement, bifactorMeasurement),
        fullMeasurement = congenialPartialFit,
        VWLE=TRUE,
        g=c("Reference", "Reference:Male"),
        s=list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism"), c("Psychopathy:Male", "Narcissism:Male")),
        covariatesVWLE = c("Male"),
        group="Male",
        groupLabels = c("0", "1"),
        invariance = list(c("loadings", "intercepts"), c("loadings", "intercepts")),
        groupFree = list(freeBPAQ, freeSD3),
        data = replicationData,
        masterSeed = masterSeed
      )
    }
    
    if(!restartLocal) {
      structuralFit <- dplyr::bind_rows(storedResults, structuralFit)
      rm(storedResults)
    } else {
      structuralFit <- dplyr::bind_rows(structuralFit)
    }
    
    attr(structuralFit, "lastAttempt") <- setEnd
    
    saveRDS(structuralFit, bootPath)
    
    restartLocal <- FALSE
    
    rm(structuralFit)
  }
}
```

### Exploratory table

#### HTML

```{r}

outcomeLevels <- c(
  "Physical",
  "Verbal",
  "Hostility",
  "Anger"
)

outcomeLabels <- c(
  "Physical (Z)",
  "Verbal (Z)",
  "Hostility (Z)",
  "Anger (Z)"
)

termLevels <- c(
  "Male",
  "Reference",
  "Reference:Male",
  "Psychopathy",
  "Psychopathy:Male",
  "Narcissism",
  "Narcissism:Male",
  "",
  "R2",
  "N"
)

termLabels <- c(
  "Male",
  "Reference (Z)",
  "Reference × Male",
  "Psychopathy (Z)",
  "Psychopathy × Male",
  "Narcissism (Z)",
  "Narcissism × Male",
  "Intercept",
  "R²",
  "N"
)

modelLevels <- c("saturated", "parsimonious")
modelLabels <- c("E1", "E2")

saturatedBoot$model <- "saturated"
parsimoniousBoot$model <- "parsimonious"

exploratoryTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(saturatedBoot, parsimoniousBoot) %>%
  filter(op %in% c("~", "gof") | (lhs %in% outcomeLevels & op == "~1")) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      pBoot <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      pBoot <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      pBoot <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      is.na(pBoot) & P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      is.na(pBoot) & P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      is.na(pBoot) & P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = case_when(
      pBoot < 0.001 ~ "&lt;.001",
      pBoot >= 0.001 ~ paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", pBoot))),
      is.na(pBoot) & P < 0.001 ~ "&lt;.001",
      .default = paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P))),
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)",
        Estimate, stars, SE
      ),
      op %in% c("~", "~1") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      rhs == "N" ~ sprintf("%.0f", Estimate),
      .default = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate)
    ),
    Outcome = factor(
      lhs,
      levels = outcomeLevels,
      labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    Model = factor(
      model,
      levels = modelLevels,
      labels = modelLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      case_when(
        op %in% c("~", "~1") & !endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ "Structural",
        op %in% c("~", "~1") & endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ "VWLE",
        op == "gof" ~ "Model information",
        .default = ""
      ),
      levels = c("Structural", "VWLE", "Model information")
    ),
    Term = factor(
      sub("VWLE$", "", rhs), 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome,
    Term,
    Model,
    Estimate,
    Panel
  )

exploratoryTableFull <- exploratoryTable %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Panel, Term)

exploratoryTableLean <- exploratoryTable %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(!(Term %in% c("Age", "Intercept"))) %>%
```

#### LaTeX

```{r}

if(export) {
  
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------ LEAN TABLE ---------------------------------------
  
  exploratoryTableLatex <- exploratoryTableLean %>%
    mutate(
      Panel = as.character(Panel),
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "Reference × Male" = "Reference $\\times$ Male",
        "Psychopathy × Male" = "Psychopathy $\\times$ Male",
        "Narcissism × Male" = "Narcissism $\\times$ Male",
        "R²" = "$\\text{R}^2$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Panel, Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  
  # Determine panel positions automatically
  panelRuns <- rle(exploratoryTableLatex$Panel)
  
  panelIndex <- stats::setNames(
    panelRuns$lengths,
    panelRuns$values
  )
  
  panelSizes <- table(exploratoryTableLatex$Panel)
  
  nPredictors <- unname(panelSizes["Structural"])
  nVWLE <- unname(panelSizes["VWLE"])
  nModelInfo <- unname(panelSizes["Model information"])
  
  exploratoryKable <- exploratoryTableLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 8)),

        " " = 1,

        "Verbal (Z)" = 2,
        "Hostility (Z)" = 2,

      ),

      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "VWLE",

      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",

      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "Model information",
      start_row = nPredictors + nVWLE + 1,
      end_row = nPredictors + nVWLE + nModelInfo,
      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,

    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(exploratoryKable),

  )
  
  # ------------------------------------ FULL TABLE ---------------------------------------
  
  exploratoryFullLatex <- exploratoryTableFull %>%
```

### Exploratory plot

#### Trait slopes

```{r}

DTFS <- lavPredict(congenialPartialFit, method = "Regression", transform = FALSE)
caseIdx <- unlist(lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "case.idx"), use.names = FALSE)
DTFSmat <- do.call(rbind, DTFS)
FSDF <- cbind(
  replicationData[caseIdx, , drop = FALSE],
  DTFSmat
)

pMale <- mean(replicationData$Male)
pFemale <- 1 - pMale

gBase <- c("Reference")

# ------------------------------------ POOLED MOMENTS --------------------------------------

groupCov  <- lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "cov.lv")
groupMean <- lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "mean.lv")

meanDifference <- groupMean[[1]] - groupMean[[2]]

pooledCov <-
  pFemale * groupCov[[1]] +
  pMale   * groupCov[[2]] +
  pFemale * pMale * tcrossprod(meanDifference)

pooledMean <-
  pFemale * groupMean[[1]] +
  pMale   * groupMean[[2]]

# --------------------------------- REDUCED FORM COVARIANCE --------------------------------

phi_g <- pooledCov[rownames(pooledCov) %in% gBase, colnames(pooledCov) %in% gBase, drop=FALSE]

phi_s <- pooledCov[!(rownames(pooledCov) %in% gBase), !(colnames(pooledCov) %in% gBase), drop=FALSE]

phi_gs <- pooledCov[rownames(pooledCov) %in% gBase, !(colnames(pooledCov) %in% gBase), drop=FALSE]

# ---------------------------------- FIRST ORDER LOADINGS ----------------------------------

lambdaMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "est")$`0`$lambda)[lavNames(congenialPartialFit, type="ov.ind"), lavNames(congenialPartialFit, type="lv")]

lambda_x <- lambdaMatrix[, !(colnames(lambdaMatrix) %in% gBase), drop = FALSE]

lambda_x_xi <- lambdaMatrix[, gBase, drop = FALSE]

lambda_xi <- solve(t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x) %*% t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x_xi

# ---------------------------------- FIRST ORDER MOMENTS ----------------------------------

firstTerm <- lambda_xi %*% phi_g %*% t(lambda_xi)

secondTerm <- lambda_xi %*% phi_gs
```

#### Sex differences

```{r}

DTFS <- lavPredict(congenialPartialFit, method = "Regression", transform = FALSE)
caseIdx <- unlist(lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "case.idx"), use.names = FALSE)
DTFSmat <- do.call(rbind, DTFS)
FSDF <- cbind(
  replicationData[caseIdx, , drop = FALSE],
  DTFSmat
)

pMale <- mean(replicationData$Male)
pFemale <- 1 - pMale

gBase <- c("Reference")

# ------------------------------------ POOLED MOMENTS --------------------------------------

groupCov  <- lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "cov.lv")
groupMean <- lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "mean.lv")

meanDifference <- groupMean[[1]] - groupMean[[2]]

pooledCov <-
  pFemale * groupCov[[1]] +
  pMale   * groupCov[[2]] +
  pFemale * pMale * tcrossprod(meanDifference)

pooledMean <-
  pFemale * groupMean[[1]] +
  pMale   * groupMean[[2]]

# --------------------------------- REDUCED FORM COVARIANCE --------------------------------

phi_g <- pooledCov[rownames(pooledCov) %in% gBase, colnames(pooledCov) %in% gBase, drop=FALSE]

phi_s <- pooledCov[!(rownames(pooledCov) %in% gBase), !(colnames(pooledCov) %in% gBase), drop=FALSE]

phi_gs <- pooledCov[rownames(pooledCov) %in% gBase, !(colnames(pooledCov) %in% gBase), drop=FALSE]

# ---------------------------------- FIRST ORDER LOADINGS ----------------------------------

lambdaMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "est")$`0`$lambda)[lavNames(congenialPartialFit, type="ov.ind"), lavNames(congenialPartialFit, type="lv")]

lambda_x <- lambdaMatrix[, !(colnames(lambdaMatrix) %in% gBase), drop = FALSE]

lambda_x_xi <- lambdaMatrix[, gBase, drop = FALSE]

lambda_xi <- solve(t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x) %*% t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x_xi

# ---------------------------------- FIRST ORDER MOMENTS ----------------------------------

firstTerm <- lambda_xi %*% phi_g %*% t(lambda_xi)

secondTerm <- lambda_xi %*% phi_gs

thirdTerm <- t(phi_gs) %*% t(lambda_xi)

phi_1 <- firstTerm + secondTerm + thirdTerm + phi_s

mean_1 <- setNames(
  as.numeric(
    lambda_xi %*% pooledMean[gBase] +
      pooledMean[rownames(lambda_xi)]
  ),
  rownames(lambda_xi)
)

# ----------------------------- IMPLIED FIRST ORDER PREDICTORS ------------------------------

FSDF$PsychopathyFO <-
  lambda_xi["Psychopathy", "Reference"] * FSDF$Reference +
  FSDF$Psychopathy

FSDF$NarcissismFO <-
  lambda_xi["Narcissism", "Reference"] * FSDF$Reference +
  FSDF$Narcissism

FSDF$PsychopathyFO <-
  (FSDF$PsychopathyFO - mean_1["Psychopathy"]) /
  sqrt(phi_1["Psychopathy", "Psychopathy"])

FSDF$NarcissismFO <-
  (FSDF$NarcissismFO - mean_1["Narcissism"]) /
  sqrt(phi_1["Narcissism", "Narcissism"])

lvNames <- lavNames(congenialPartialFit, "lv")

FSDF[, lvNames] <- sweep(
  sweep(
    as.matrix(FSDF[, lvNames]),
    MARGIN = 2,
    STATS = pooledMean[lvNames],
    FUN = "-"
  ),
  MARGIN = 2,
  STATS = sqrt(diag(pooledCov))[lvNames],
  FUN = "/"
)

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      colour = "grey88"
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        linewidth = 1.5,
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  )
```

## Sensitivity

### Correlated factors

```{r}

set.seed(masterSeed)

correlatedStructuralModel <- gsub(
  "Reference",
  "Machiavellianism",
  parsimoniousModel,
  fixed = TRUE
)

if (parallelSupported) {
  structuralFit <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
    X = 1:M,
    FUN = plausibleFun,
    structuralModel = correlatedStructuralModel,
    measurementFit = congenialFirstOrderFit,
    VWLE=FALSE,
    g=NULL,
    s=NULL,
    covariatesVWLE = NULL,
    data = replicationData,
    masterSeed = masterSeed,
    mc.cores = availableCores,
    mc.set.seed = TRUE
  )
} else {
  structuralFit <- lapply(
    X = 1:M,
    FUN = plausibleFun,
    structuralModel = correlatedStructuralModel,
    measurementFit = congenialFirstOrderFit,
    VWLE=FALSE,
    g=NULL,
    s=NULL,
    covariatesVWLE = NULL,
    data = replicationData,
    masterSeed = masterSeed
  )
}

correlatedFactorsFit <- processFunPV(structuralFit)

bootPath <- "../Data/correlatedFactorsBoot.rds"

targetReached <- FALSE
restartLocal <- restartBootstraps

while (runBootstraps && !targetReached) {
  
  if(!restartLocal) {
    storedResults <- readRDS(bootPath)
    lastAttempt <- attr(storedResults, "lastAttempt")
    setStart <- lastAttempt + 1L
    remainingDraws <- B - n_distinct(storedResults$draw)
    setEnd <- setStart + remainingDraws - 1L
  } else {
    setStart <- 1
    setEnd <- B
  }
  
  targetReached <- setStart > setEnd
  
  if (!targetReached) {
  
    if (parallelSupported && setStart < setEnd) {
      structuralFit <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
        X = setStart:setEnd,
        FUN = bootFun,
        mDraws = MB,
        structuralModel = correlatedStructuralModel,
        measurementModel = list(responseMeasurement, firstOrderMeasurement),
        fullMeasurement = congenialFirstOrderFit,
        VWLE=FALSE,
        g=NULL,
        s=NULL,
        covariatesVWLE = NULL,
        group="Male",
        groupLabels = c("0", "1"),
        invariance = list(c("loadings", "intercepts"), c("loadings", "intercepts")),
        groupFree = list(freeBPAQ, freeSD3),
        data = replicationData,
        masterSeed = masterSeed,
        mc.cores = availableCores,
        mc.set.seed = TRUE
      )
    } else {
      structuralFit <- lapply(
        X = setStart:setEnd,
        FUN = bootFun,
        mDraws = MB,
        structuralModel = correlatedStructuralModel,
        measurementModel = list(responseMeasurement, firstOrderMeasurement),
        fullMeasurement = congenialFirstOrderFit,
        VWLE=FALSE,
        g=NULL,
        s=NULL,
        covariatesVWLE = NULL,
        group="Male",
        groupLabels = c("0", "1"),
        invariance = list(c("loadings", "intercepts"), c("loadings", "intercepts")),
        groupFree = list(freeBPAQ, freeSD3),
        data = replicationData,
        masterSeed = masterSeed
      )
    }
  
    if(!restartLocal) {
      structuralFit <- dplyr::bind_rows(storedResults, structuralFit)
      rm(storedResults)
    } else {
      structuralFit <- dplyr::bind_rows(structuralFit)
    }
    
    attr(structuralFit, "lastAttempt") <- setEnd
    
    saveRDS(structuralFit, bootPath)
    
    restartLocal <- FALSE
    
    rm(structuralFit)
  }
}


correlatedFactorsBoot <- processFunBoot(correlatedFactorsFit, readRDS("../Data/correlatedFactorsBoot.rds")) %>%
  mutate(
    isReference = ifelse(rhs=="Reference", 1, 0),
    rhs = recode(
      rhs,
      Machiavellianism = "Machiavellianism (FO)",
      Psychopathy = "Psychopathy (FO)",
      Narcissism = "Narcissism (FO)"
    ),
    reference = "Correlated"
  )

correlatedFactorsBoot %>%
  filter(op %in% c("~", "gof") & rhs != "N") %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, rhs, Estimate, SE, Z, P, pBoot, meanBoot, biasBoot, bootSuccess, bootRate) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Estimate, SE, Z, P, pBoot, meanBoot, biasBoot, bootRate), \(x) round(x, digits = 3))
  )
```
