### Sensitivity table

#### HTML

```{r}

outcomeLevels <- c(
  "Physical",
  "Verbal",
  "Hostility",
  "Anger"
)

outcomeLabels <- c(
  "Physical",
  "Verbal",
  "Hostility",
  "Anger"
)

termLevels <- c(
  "Machiavellianism (FO)",
  "Psychopathy (FO)",
  "Narcissism (FO)",
  "Machiavellianism (S)",
  "Psychopathy (S)",
  "Narcissism (S)",
  "Male",
  "",
  "R2"
)

termLabels <- c(
  "Mach (FO)",
  "Psych (FO)",
  "Narc (FO)",
  "Mach (S)",
  "Psych (S)",
  "Narc (S)",
  "Male",
  "Intercept",
  "R²"
)

modelLevels <- c("Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy", "Narcissism", "Correlated")
modelLabels <- c("Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy", "Narcissism", "Correlated")

sensitivityTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  machiavellianismReferenceBoot, 
  psychopathyReferenceBoot,
  narcissismReferenceBoot,
  correlatedFactorsBoot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    lhs %in% outcomeLevels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rhs = recode(
      rhs, 
      Machiavellianism = "Machiavellianism (S)",
      Psychopathy = "Psychopathy (S)",
      Narcissism = "Narcissism (S)"
    ),
    rhs = sub("VWLE$", " (FO)", rhs),
    stars = case_when(
      pBoot <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      pBoot <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      pBoot <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      is.na(pBoot) & P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      is.na(pBoot) & P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      is.na(pBoot) & P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = case_when(
      pBoot < 0.001 ~ "&lt;.001",
      pBoot >= 0.001 ~ paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", pBoot))),
      is.na(pBoot) & P < 0.001 ~ "&lt;.001",
      .default = paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P))),
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      isReference == 1 ~ sprintf(
        "<span style='font-weight:bold;'>%.3f%s</span><br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
#        "<span style='font-weight:bold;'>%.3f</span><br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
#        Estimate, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      op %in% c("~", "~1") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
#        "%.3f<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
#        Estimate, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      .default = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate)
    ),
    Outcome = factor(
      lhs,
      levels = outcomeLevels,
      labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    Model = factor(
      reference,
      levels = modelLevels,
      labels = modelLabels
    ),
    Term = factor(
      rhs, 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      case_when(
        endsWith(rhs, "(FO)") ~ "First order",
        op == "gof" ~ "Model information",
        .default = "Specific"
      ),
      levels = c("First order", "Specific", "Model information")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome,
    Term,
    Model,
    Estimate,
    Panel
  )

sensitivityTableFull <- sensitivityTable %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Outcome),
    !is.na(Panel),
    !is.na(Term)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Panel, Term)

sensitivityTableLean <- sensitivityTable %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Outcome),
    !is.na(Panel),
    Term %in% c(
      "Mach (FO)",
      "Psych (FO)",
      "Narc (FO)",
      "R²"
    ),
    Outcome %in% c("Physical", "Verbal", "Hostility")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = forcats::fct_drop(Outcome)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Panel, Term)

sensitivityGT <- sensitivityTableLean %>%
  dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
  gt::gt(
    rowname_col = "Term"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Bifactor (S-1)",
    id = "bifactor_physical",
    level = 1,
    columns = starts_with("Physical_") &
      ends_with(c("Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy", "Narcissism"))
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Bifactor (S-1)",
    id = "bifactor_verbal",
    level = 1,
    columns = starts_with("Verbal_") &
      ends_with(c("Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy", "Narcissism"))
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Bifactor (S-1)",
    id = "bifactor_hostility",
    level = 1,
    columns = starts_with("Hostility_") &
      ends_with(c("Machiavellianism", "Psychopathy", "Narcissism"))
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Physical",
    columns = starts_with("Physical_")
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Verbal",
    columns = starts_with("Verbal_")
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Hostility",
    columns = starts_with("Hostility_")
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    ends_with("Correlated") ~ "C3F",
    ends_with("Machiavellianism") ~ "Mach",
    ends_with("Psychopathy") ~ "Psych",
    ends_with("Narcissism") ~ "Narc"
  ) %>%
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = -Term
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -Term
  ) %>%
  gt::sub_missing(
    columns = -Term,
    missing_text = "—"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups(
      groups = everything()
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    ),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_stub(
        rows = Term %in% c("Mach (S)", "R²")
      ),
      gt::cells_body(
        rows = Term %in% c("Mach (S)", "R²")
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Verdana", "Arial", "sans-serif"),
    table.font.size = gt::px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(0),
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = gt::px(1),
    table_body.hlines.width = gt::px(0)
  )

sensitivityGT

    )
```

#### LaTeX

```{r}

if(export) {
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Convert the bold HTML span to LaTeX
    x <- gsub(
      "<span style='font-weight:bold;'>(.*?)</span>",
      "\\\\textbf{\\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  # ------------------------------------ LEAN TABLE ---------------------------------------
  
  sensitivityTableLatex <- sensitivityTableLean %>%
    mutate(
      Panel = as.character(Panel),
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "R²" = "$\\text{R}^2$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Panel, Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  
  # Determine panel positions automatically
  panelRuns <- rle(sensitivityTableLatex$Panel)
  
  panelIndex <- stats::setNames(
    panelRuns$lengths,
    panelRuns$values
  )
  
  panelSizes <- table(sensitivityTableLatex$Panel)
  
  nFO <- unname(panelSizes["First order"])
  nS <- unname(panelSizes["Specific"])
  nModelInfo <- unname(panelSizes["Model information"])
  
  sensitivityKable <- sensitivityTableLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 12)),
      col.names = c("", rep(c("Mach", "Psych", "Narc", "C3F"), 3))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(sensitivityTableLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Physical" = 4,
        "Verbal" = 4,
        "Hostility" = 4
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = setdiff(
        seq_len(nrow(sensitivityTableLatex) - 1),
        nFO
      ),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    # Separator after the first-order estimates
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = nFO,
      extra_latex_after = "\\specialrule{0.3pt}{0.65em}{0.35em}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(sensitivityKable),
    "../Tables/sensitivityTable.tex"
  )
  
  
  # ------------------------------------ FULL TABLE ---------------------------------------
  
  
  sensitivityFullLatex <- sensitivityTableFull %>%
    mutate(
      Panel = as.character(Panel),
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "R²" = "$\\text{R}^2$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Panel, Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  
  # Determine panel positions automatically
  panelRuns <- rle(sensitivityFullLatex$Panel)
  
  panelIndex <- stats::setNames(
    panelRuns$lengths,
    panelRuns$values
  )
  
  panelSizes <- table(sensitivityFullLatex$Panel)
  
  nFO <- unname(panelSizes["First order"])
  nS <- unname(panelSizes["Specific"])
  nModelInfo <- unname(panelSizes["Model information"])
  
  sensitivityFullKable <- sensitivityFullLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 16)),
      col.names = c("", rep(c("Mach", "Psych", "Narc", "C3F"), 4))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(sensitivityFullLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1,
        "Bifactor ($\\\\mathbf{S-1}$)" = 3, " " = 1
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Physical" = 4,
        "Verbal" = 4,
        "Hostility" = 4,
        "Anger" = 4
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    # Ordinary spacing within panels
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = setdiff(
        seq_len(nrow(sensitivityFullLatex) - 1),
        c(nFO, nFO + nS)
      ),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    # Explicit, equal spacing around panel separators
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = c(nFO, nFO + nS),

    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,

    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",

  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(sensitivityFullKable),
    "../Tables/sensitivityTableFull.tex"
  )
}
```

# Supplemental

### Variance-Weighted Latent Effect

The type-2 Variance-Weighted Latent Effect introduced in this project targets the partial effect of a first-order factor while holding all non-overlapping components and covariates fixed, but relaxing the conditional interpretation with respect to overlapping components. Here, we illustrate the equivalent parametrizations that recover the VWLEs reported alongside the VWLE recovery. The reference model in this exercise includes all latent components and their interactions with sex. Each equivalent first-order parametrization expresses the target factor in first-order coordinates while retaining all non-overlapping residual components, covariates, and corresponding interaction terms.

```{r}

set.seed(masterSeed)

DTFS <- lavPredict(congenialPartialFit, method = "Regression", transform = FALSE)
caseIdx <- unlist(lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "case.idx"), use.names = FALSE)
DTFSmat <- do.call(rbind, DTFS)
FSDF <- cbind(
  replicationData[caseIdx, , drop = FALSE],
  DTFSmat
)

gBase <- c("Reference")

lambdaMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(congenialPartialFit, "est")$`0`$lambda)[lavNames(congenialPartialFit, type="ov.ind"), lavNames(congenialPartialFit, type="lv")]

lambda_x <- lambdaMatrix[, !(colnames(lambdaMatrix) %in% gBase), drop = FALSE]

lambda_x_xi <- lambdaMatrix[, gBase, drop = FALSE]

lambda_xi <- solve(t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x) %*% t(lambda_x) %*% lambda_x_xi

# ---------------------------------- REFERENCE MODEL -------------------------------------

structuralFit <- sem(
  model=saturatedModel,
  estimator="MLR",
  meanstructure=TRUE,
  data = FSDF
)

response <- c(
  lavNames(structuralFit, type = "ov.y"),
  lavNames(structuralFit, type = "lv.y")
)

g <- c("Reference", "Reference:Male")

s <- list(c("Psychopathy", "Narcissism"), c("Psychopathy:Male", "Narcissism:Male"))

covariates <- c("Male")

coefMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "est")$beta)[response, ] #Ensure order

order <- colnames(coefMatrix)

covMatrix <- as.matrix(lavInspect(structuralFit, "cov.all"))

covMatrix <- covMatrix[order, order, drop=FALSE]

vwleResult <- vwleFun(
  response=response, 
  g=g, 
  s=s, 
  covariates=covariates, 
  lambdaMatrix=lambdaMatrix,
  covMatrix=covMatrix,
  coefMatrix=coefMatrix
)

vwleList <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(vwleResult$lvl)), 
  function(i) {
    out <- lapply(
      seq_len(ncol(vwleResult$lvl)), 
      function(j){
        return(vwleResult$lvl[i,j, drop=FALSE])
      }
    )
    return(out)
  }
)

vwleList <- unlist(vwleList, recursive=FALSE)

vwleRows <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    vwleList,
    function(i) {
      left <- rownames(i)
      right <- colnames(i)
      
      target <- coefMatrix[left, right]
      
      if(target == 0) {
        # Do not extract the VWLE if a specific component is absent from the corresponding equation
        return(NULL)
      } else {
        vwleRows <- tibble::tibble(
          lhs = left,
          op = "~",
          rhs = paste0(right, "VWLE"),
          est = as.numeric(i),
          se = NA,
          z = NA,
          pvalue = NA
        )
        return(vwleRows)
      }
    }
  )
)

# ----------------------------- PSYCHOPATHY PARAMETRIZATION ---------------------------------

FSDF$PsychopathyFO <-
  lambda_xi["Psychopathy", "Reference"] * FSDF$Reference +
  FSDF$Psychopathy

structuralModel <- '
  Physical ~ Male + Narcissism + PsychopathyFO + PsychopathyFO:Male + Narcissism:Male
  Verbal ~ Male + Narcissism + PsychopathyFO + PsychopathyFO:Male + Narcissism:Male
  Hostility ~ Male + Narcissism + PsychopathyFO + PsychopathyFO:Male + Narcissism:Male
  Anger ~ Male + Narcissism + PsychopathyFO + PsychopathyFO:Male + Narcissism:Male
  
  Physical ~~ Verbal
  Physical ~~ Hostility
  Physical ~~ Anger
  Verbal ~~ Hostility
  Verbal ~~ Anger
  Hostility ~~ Anger
'

psychopathyFit <- sem(
  model=structuralModel,
  estimator="MLR",
  meanstructure=TRUE,
  data = FSDF
)

psychopathyTable <- parameterEstimates(psychopathyFit) %>%
  filter(op=="~" & grepl("FO", rhs, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ci.lower, ci.upper))

# ----------------------------- NARCISSISM PARAMETRIZATION ---------------------------------

FSDF$NarcissismFO <-
  lambda_xi["Narcissism", "Reference"] * FSDF$Reference +
  FSDF$Narcissism

structuralModel <- '
  Physical ~ Male + NarcissismFO + Psychopathy + Psychopathy:Male + NarcissismFO:Male
  Verbal ~ Male + NarcissismFO + Psychopathy + Psychopathy:Male + NarcissismFO:Male
  Hostility ~ Male + NarcissismFO + Psychopathy + Psychopathy:Male + NarcissismFO:Male
  Anger ~ Male + NarcissismFO + Psychopathy + Psychopathy:Male + NarcissismFO:Male
  
  Physical ~~ Verbal
  Physical ~~ Hostility
  Physical ~~ Anger
  Verbal ~~ Hostility
  Verbal ~~ Anger
  Hostility ~~ Anger
'

narcissismFit <- sem(
  model=structuralModel,
  estimator="MLR",
  meanstructure=TRUE,
  data = FSDF
)

narcissismTable <- parameterEstimates(narcissismFit) %>%
  filter(op=="~" & grepl("FO", rhs, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ci.lower, ci.upper))

# ----------------------------- COMPARISON TABLE -------------------------------------

vwleTable <- bind_rows(
  psychopathyTable,
  narcissismTable
) %>%
  mutate(
    rhs = sub("FO", "", rhs),
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    vwleRows %>%
      transmute(
        lhs,
        op,
        rhs = sub("VWLE$", "", rhs),
        VWLE = est
      ),
    by = c("lhs", "op", "rhs")
  )
    
vwleTable %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, est, VWLE, se, z, pvalue)
```

```{r}

if(export) {
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  comparisonTableLatex <- comparisonTable %>%
    mutate(
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "Psychopathy × Male" = "Psychopathy $\\times$ Male",
        "Narcissism × Male" = "Narcissism $\\times$ Male"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  comparisonKable <- comparisonTableLatex %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 8)),
      col.names = c("", rep(c("Direct", "VWLE"), 4))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(comparisonTableLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Physical" = 2,
        "Verbal" = 2,
        "Hostility" = 2,
        "Anger" = 2
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(comparisonKable),
    "../Tables/comparisonTable.tex"
  )
}
```

```{r}
modelLevels <- c("metric", "scalar")
modelLabels <- c("Metric", "Scalar")

metricStructuralFit$model <- "metric"
scalarStructuralFit$model <- "scalar"

invarianceSensitivityTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(metricStructuralFit, scalarStructuralFit) %>%
  filter(op %in% c("~", "gof") | (lhs %in% outcomeLevels & op == "~1")) %>%
  filter(!endsWith(rhs, "VWLE")) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      P < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P)))
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      op %in% c("~", "~1") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      rhs == "N" ~ sprintf("%.0f", Estimate),
      .default = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate)
    ),
    Outcome = factor(
      lhs,
      levels = outcomeLevels,
      labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    Model = factor(
      model,
      levels = modelLevels,
      labels = modelLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      case_when(
        op %in% c("~", "~1") & !endsWith(rhs, "VWLE") ~ "Structural",
        op == "gof" ~ "Model information",
        .default = ""
      ),
      levels = c("Structural", "Model information")
    ),
    Term = factor(
      rhs, 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome,
    Term,
    Model,
    Estimate,
    Panel
  )

    names_from = c(Outcome, Model),
```

##### LaTeX

```{r}

if(export) {
  
  # Convert one HTML-formatted result cell to LaTeX
  toLatexCell <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return("\\textemdash{}")
    }
    
    x <- gsub("&lt;", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
    
    # Replace each complete star sequence exactly once
    x <- gsub(
      "(\\*{1,3})",
      "{\\\\tiny \\1}",
      x,
      perl = TRUE
    )
    
    lines <- strsplit(x, "<br>", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    paste0(
      "\\makecell{",
      paste(lines, collapse = " \\\\ "),
      "}"
    )
  }
  
  invarianceSensitivityLatex <- invarianceSensitivityTable %>%
    mutate(
      Panel = as.character(Panel),
      Term = as.character(Term),
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "Reference × Male" = "Reference $\\times$ Male",
        "Psychopathy × Male" = "Psychopathy $\\times$ Male",
        "Narcissism × Male" = "Narcissism $\\times$ Male",
        "R²" = "$\\text{R}^2$"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        -c(Panel, Term),
        \(x) vapply(x, toLatexCell, character(1))
      )
    )
  
  
  # Determine panel positions automatically
  panelRuns <- rle(invarianceSensitivityLatex$Panel)
  
  panelIndex <- stats::setNames(
    panelRuns$lengths,
    panelRuns$values
  )
  
  panelSizes <- table(invarianceSensitivityLatex$Panel)
  
  nPredictors <- unname(panelSizes["Structural"])
  nModelInfo <- unname(panelSizes["Model information"])
  
  invarianceSensitivityKable <- invarianceSensitivityLatex %>%
    dplyr::select(-Panel) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", rep("c", 8)),
      col.names = c("Structural", rep(c("Metric", "Scalar"), 4))
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = seq_len(nrow(invarianceSensitivityLatex) - 1),
      extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.5em]"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::add_header_above(
      c(
        " " = 1,
        "Physical (Z)" = 2,
        "Verbal (Z)" = 2,
        "Hostility (Z)" = 2,
        "Anger (Z)" = 2
      ),
      escape = FALSE,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::pack_rows(
      "Model information",
      start_row = nPredictors + 1,
      end_row = nPredictors + nModelInfo,
      bold = TRUE,
      hline_after = FALSE,
      extra_latex_after = "\\midrule ",
      indent = FALSE,
      escape = FALSE,
      latex_align = "@{}l@{}"
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(
      row = 0,
      bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = "basic",
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "left"
    )
  
  writeLines(
    stretchLatexTable(invarianceSensitivityKable),
    "../Tables/invarianceSensitivityTable.tex"
  )
}
```
